cohort: The study included 110 preterm babies born between 23 and 26 weeks of gestation, hospitalized from 2009 to 2014 at the Department of Neonatology of Poznan University of Medical Sciences.
finding: Lower gestational age and treatment for hypotension with catecholamines were associated with an increased risk of IVH stage 3 and 4, while prenatal steroid therapy was protective.
